messages:
Sam W: CI on main is red — image publish step failing for staging runtime image, looks like push failed in publish stage. Anyone oncall? :eyes:
ci-bot: build-8472 failed · stage: publish-image · exit_code: 1
ci-bot: last logs:
```
#22 pushing layers
INFO: pushing layer 0/5
error: failed to upload blob: write tcp 10.2.3.4:41324->10.4.0.7:443: write: broken pipe
error: manifest push rejected: manifest invalid
```
Jin K: paste the specific error please, trying to grep registry logs.
Sam W: pasted above — here's raw snippet from the job log (same as ci-bot). This started after the Dockerfile change in PR #5237 that switched to a different cache strategy.
Marta L: hmm could be short-lived token or registry flapping. We rotated staging creds last night — Tyler, did we update the deploy runners?
Tyler P: we rotated staging service account at 06:00 UTC and rolled the runners, yes. Not aware of issues. Will check KV access.
Jin K: can someone try a manual push from one of the runners? `docker pull` then `docker tag` then `docker push` to see if it's CI-only.
Sam W: running now from runner-3.
Sam W: command:
```
docker pull registry.redwood-internal.com/base:sha123
docker tag registry.redwood-internal.com/base:sha123 registry.redwood-internal.com/staging/redwood-runtime:canary-202403
docker push registry.redwood-internal.com/staging/redwood-runtime:canary-202403
```
Sam W: got same error on manual push: `Error uploading layer: unexpected EOF` then `manifest rejected: manifest invalid`
Marta L: that points to registry-side acceptance issue or a proxy between runner and registry (chunking). Jin — can you tail the registry logs for 10.4.0.7 around the time?
Jin K: tailing now. I'm seeing repeated 401s followed by 500s: `http: TLS handshake error from 10.2.3.4: short buffer` and `blob-upload session aborted: write failed`
Tyler P: I checked the ingress — we had a partial cert reload during the cred rotation window. Maybe a stale TLS session causing EOF on chunked uploads.
Marta L: good call. For short-term mitigation can we switch CI to use the backup registry `staging-backup.redwood`? That one hasn't had the cert reload.
Sam W: I can update the pipeline to push to backup registry and re-run the failing job, will do in 5.
ci-bot: build-8472 re-run requested by Sam W
ci-bot: build-8472 re-run started on runner-5
Sam W: rerun succeeded pushing to staging-backup. So CI green if we target backup.
Jin K: OK that proves the runner/Dockerfile is fine. We need infra to investigate the primary registry TLS reload and cert chain.
Tyler P: filing infra ticket (INFRA-2117) with logs + timestamps. Also will revert the cert reload on primary and re-run a couple manual pushes.
Marta L: also, note PR #5237 changed `--mount=type=cache` usage — if registry has flaky chunking it increases multi-layer push simultaneity. Might exacerbate. Consider switching to sequential layer push (one at a time) as a fallback in buildkit config.
Sam W: quick ask: can someone bisect if PR #5237 correlates to first observed failures? I can roll back the PR if needed.
Jin K: I checked git history: last successful main build was at ts 1923420000, PR #5237 merged at 1923449000, first failures at 1923456000. Looks correlated.
Tyler P: I'll temporarily revert the Dockerfile changes in a new commit to see if primary registry accepts pushes again.
Tyler P: revert commit pushed, manual push now to primary registry: `docker push ...`
Tyler P: push still failing with same EOF/manifest invalid. So revert didn't help — leaning more infra (TLS/proxy).
Marta L: ok infra triage is priority. Meanwhile I'll land a small pipeline change to fallback to `staging-backup` for the publish step if primary push fails twice. Keeps main green.
Sam W: thanks. I'll open a follow-up incident note and add a quick postmortem template. If infra confirms cert reload caused partial connection closures we'll document rollback and add a canary TLS reload step for future.
Jin K: noted. INFRA-2117 created, assigned to Tyler. I'll attach registry logs and runner tcpdumps.
Sam W: thanks all. Reactions: :thumbsup: on workaround. Will update the PRs and pipeline in the morning.
ci-bot: build-8472 · finished (successful with backup registry fallback)
Marta L: follow-up action: add a 5-minute wait after cert roll and test a 100MB layer push in staging. Putting it on infra runbook.
Sam W: copying runbook item to infra-runbook repo and closing thread after infra confirms fix.
Tyler P: will post update here when INFRA-2117 is resolved.
